title: Structural query probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and suppose the space of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ has a finite nonempty orthonormal basis for the $\pi$-weighted inner product, containing the constant-one function as one of its basis vectors. For any finite decision tree on an available set of coordinates and any coordinate $i$, the probability that the tree queries $i$ on an independent $\pi$-distributed input equals the recursively defined structural query probability of $i$ in the tree.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution $\pi$ on $\Omega$ is given
There is a finite nonempty index set for a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$
The basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
One basis vector is the constant-one function
A finite decision tree on an available set of coordinates is given
